newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue rules to regulate investment funds.
newsitem.headline: China to issue rules to regulate investment funds.

text.p: China will soon issue rules aimed at regulating the nation's rapidly-growing investment funds industry, the Market Daily said on Monday.

Two sets of regulations, titled the Securities Investment Funds Management Rules and the Sino-Foreign Investment Fund Management Rules, were in the final stages of revision and approval, the newspaper quoted Yin Jieyan, vice president of the People's Bank of China, as saying.
The newspaper gave no details of the rules.
Financial officials have said that many new funds were waiting for the announcement of the regulations before starting operations.
They added that many existing regulations were unclear and funds now in operation were not standardised.
Many foreign financial firms have been waiting for regulations to govern the possible role of foreign companies in fund management and investment.
Yin was quoted as saying that China needed to clarify regulations to strengthen control over investment funds, but no further details were given.
